Tuesday, January 12, 2027 Security Releases

The Node.js Project

Summary

The Node.js project will release new versions of the 26.x, 24.x, 22.x releases lines on or shortly after, Tuesday, January 12, 2027 in order to address:

  • 2 high severity issues.
  • 3 medium severity issues.
  • 1 low severity issue.

Impact

The 26.x release line of Node.js is vulnerable to 2 high severity issues, 3 medium severity issues, 1 low severity issue. The 24.x release line of Node.js is vulnerable to 1 high severity issue, 2 medium severity issues.

It's important to note that End-of-Life versions are always affected when a security release occurs.

Release timing

Releases will be available on, or shortly after, Tuesday, January 12, 2027.

Contact and future updates

The current Node.js security policy can be found at https://nodejs.org/en/security/.
